shots.text: Never drain your pool. Here's why.
Under your yard, the ground is full of water.
Your pool is basically a concrete boat, sitting in it.
When it's full, the weight of the water holds it down.
But drain it, and that weight is gone.
Now the water in the ground pushes up from below...
until the whole pool pops right out of the ground.
That's why pool pros drain slowly, or not at all.
